title: Product Integration implementation plan
scope: Configure the standalone Phase 2 Product Integration application defined by the technical specification revised on 2026-11-17, with all eleven integration objects and one tab containing a separate direct menu item for each object inventory.
basis: [Technical specification, 1–10](product-management-api-technical-specification.md) is the proposed governing design; section 5 owns field settings and section 6 receive behavior.
The API dictionary supplies property mappings; the complete object model, diagram, and all three supplied JSON examples were read.
No live tenant state, actual endpoint, supported native execution method, or existing object/field metadata identity is asserted.
Existing .ipack baselines stay unchanged. The specification explicitly requires no package extraction for this new isolated design and supplies no inherited business-object targets.

User direction dated 2026-11-17 replaces Product Management / API Data ownership with the standalone Product Integration application and one tab with eleven direct inventory menu items. This revises the target design; no tenant relocation is claimed.

User direction dated 2026-11-17 supplies the existing Administrators bypass as current behavior, the exact Part Integration - Admin Security Group name and Create/View/Edit/Delete Rights, and Everyone Create/Edit/Delete Audit Trail settings across all eleven objects.

The latest user direction adds application and tab Use for Part Integration - Admin Security Group and requires all human-access references to use the supplied two-group administration model. Everyone remains an audit audience only.

The latest user direction adds a separate Use Rights grant for Part Integration - Admin Security Group on every one of the eleven existing inventory menu items. The model now has 13 Use grants, 44 object Rights grants, and 33 Everyone audit settings.

externalInputs.title: Native field and raw-document storage
externalInputs.description: The technical team must supply supported text limits, Unicode long text of 65,536 characters, Decimal(19,6), localization, exact source-key comparison, and native text/document storage up to 1 MiB UTF-8. Affected field definitions and overflow checks wait for those settings; no silent truncation, rounding, or assumed JSON scalar is allowed.

externalInputs.title: Trusted feed entry and ownership
externalInputs.description: Supply authenticated connector entry/response bindings, credentials, trusted Source System namespaces, field authority, and delivery order. The specification supplies no executable endpoint, schedule, source version, or timestamp. Receive bindings and competing producers wait for these inputs. Reference sharing requires an explicitly shared namespace; stale-write and chronological guarantees remain unverified.

externalInputs.title: Consistent native saving and retries
externalInputs.description: The technical team must supply persistence calls, compound uniqueness, null-equal matching, locks and lock order, transactional batch/rollback, native staging, and retained Family create-request mapping. IMP-09 and exposed receive writes wait for these methods. If transactional saving is unavailable, hold operations in supported native staging until consistent execution is established.

externalInputs.title: Security, audit, and evidence retention
externalInputs.description: The human access model is supplied: Administrators already has full control with permission checks disabled; Part Integration - Admin Security Group receives Use via Rights on the Product Integration application, its sole tab, and each of its eleven inventory menu items, plus Create, View, Edit, and Delete via Rights on all eleven objects. These same two groups may access forms, inventories, editable local catalogue/Role fields, Raw Payload, source documents, retained records, and evidence. The thirteen Use grants are separate from the 44 object Rights grants. Everyone has Audit Trail enabled for Create, Edit, and Delete on every object and receives no Use or object access grant from this audit setting. Supply only the remaining native evidence/document bindings and approved retention settings. User membership administration remains external; no additional reader or maintenance-group policy is needed.

externalInputs.title: Family request and membership contract
externalInputs.description: Supply Family command entry, native-ID or trusted external-ID update context, stable create key, and a populated selectedPartNumbersIds example. IMP-11 cannot complete executable matching, defaults, or membership replacement before these confirmations.

externalInputs.title: Change-context identity and paging
externalInputs.description: Confirm the six-reference scope key or supply a stable row ID, repeated-row cardinality, scope ownership of Description/Comment, correction/removal rules, non-null Part/Revision shapes/keys, and page parameters, count meaning, snapshot consistency, and delivery behavior.
